second member of compound with aṣṭa

items.question: What form and status characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject.
The sixth cakra is designated as king.
The sixth cakra has eight petals.
The sixth cakra possesses a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a regal eight-petaled center endowed with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of the accusative forms is inferred from context without an explicit governing verb in this verse.
items.plain_english: But the sixth cakra is the king, eight-petaled and with a pericarp.
